entities.name: Traxos
entities.description: A dragon engine construct designed by Mishra, instrumental in the Fall of Kroog.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Ancient city destroyed by Mishra's war machines.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Leader of the Phyrexians who invaded Dominaria.

entities.name: Lyra
entities.description: Tolaria's first angel scholar who raised Traxos in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Academy Traxos protects in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Antiquities War
entities.description: War in which Kroog fell in 28 AR.

events.summary: Mishra's war machines, foremost among them Traxos, destroy Kroog during the Antiquities War in 28 AR.
events.quote: The ancient city of Kroog was destroyed by the artificer Mishra and his war machines

events.summary: Tolaria excavation teams find and inadvertently reactivate Traxos, which prowls old battlefields in search of Urza's forces.
events.quote: inadvertently reactivated the ancient war machine

events.summary: When Elesh Norn's Phyrexians invade, Traxos deems them an enemy to be exterminated.
events.quote: Traxos had no allegiance to the invaders

events.summary: In the Echoverse Lyra raises Traxos from inertia and rebuilds it as a defender of Tolaria.

relations.quote: deeming them an enemy that must be exterminated as well
